name: Vardic Holds
summary: A loose federation of industrial northern jarldoms whose culture values craftsmanship, reputation, self-reliance and deeds worth remembering.
gateAttitude: The unknown is something to master: they tend to see the Gates as another frontier to enter, understand and master.
beliefs: The Holds predominantly follow the **Old Gods of the Holds**, a tradition centred on Fate, Making and Memory, and on reputation and remembrance. Smaller First Light communities also exist, especially around trade routes and ports.
visualSummary: An industrial identity that combines heavy iron, timber, ships, maker's marks and old northern motifs.
materials: Dark iron, timber, wool, leather, knotwork

relations.text: Old naval rivalry and mutual respect.
Admiration for engineering; impatience with political argument.
Strong trade ties, distrust of debt.
Mutual respect for craft; disagreement over metaphysical caution.
Mutually useful, methodically at odds: Verna wants to study it first, the Vards want to test it.

sponsorFraming: The benefit represents Vardic training, tools or practical sponsorship.
extraRule: Once per session, when you Create an Advantage using **Crafts** by repairing, reinforcing, modifying or improvising equipment, you may treat a tie as a success with one free invoke instead.
